name: project-switcher
description: Pane listing every project and its sessions with context-window fill; resume any session in Claude Desktop, Terminal or iTerm

openIn.title: Open sessions in
openIn.description: Where a session resumes when you press it: the Claude Desktop app, or `claude --resume` in Terminal or iTerm

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a session starts
autoOpen.description: Off: the pane opens only on /projects

projectsShown.title: Projects shown
projectsShown.description: Projects listed before "Show N more projects"

warnAt.title: Context warning at (%)
warnAt.description: Fill at which a session turns yellow

dangerAt.title: Context danger at (%)
dangerAt.description: Fill at which a session turns red and counts as near limit
